purpose: Pre-register expected dry-run shapes BEFORE code; adversarial review of proximity design and on-vs-near semantics.

48113.source: SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT feature_index), min/max lng/lat FROM txgio_parcel WHERE county_fips='48113' on CORTEX_DATABASE_URL

sourceProbeEvidence.note: Harris County mirror layer; all 12,796 features fall in Harris lat/lon envelope (29.5-30.2, -96 to -94.8). Dallas and Bexar bbox queries return zero features — dry-runs will exercise the honest-absence path, not present-well joins.

proximityDesign.radiusJustification: 500 feet (~152 m). The buyer question is whether a well ON or NEAR the property affects use/value — not whether a centroid falls inside the polygon. Strict PIP misses pad-edge and shared-fence wells whose surface location sits on an adjacent tract boundary. 500 ft is the common Texas surface-impact screening distance cited in county O&G setback ordinances and environmental desktop reviews: close enough to capture the adjacent-lot pad without quarter-mile false positives in urban corridors. The radius is carried IN EVERY atom body so the claim is legible and auditable.
proximityDesign.onParcelSemantics: Well surface point (LONG83/LAT83) inside parcel polygon via ray-cast PIP on txgio_parcel geometry. parcelRelation=on-parcel, proximityDistanceMeters=0.
proximityDesign.nearParcelSemantics: Well surface point outside polygon but within proximityRadiusMeters of the parcel boundary (min distance to outer ring). parcelRelation=near-parcel, proximityDistanceMeters= measured meters.
proximityDesign.atomGranularity: One well-fact atom per (parcel, well) association — 0..N present per parcel. Parcels with zero on-or-near wells emit one typed absence (no-well-on-or-near). Plugged/injection/disposal distinguished via SYMNUM→wellStatus/wellType body fields, never collapsed to counts.

adversarialReviewCheckpoint1.proximityAttack: ATTEMPTED REFUTE: 152m too narrow for injection/disposal salience — REJECTED for v1: injection/disposal that materially affects a parcel beyond 500ft would still appear in broader O&G vertical (og-twin); this rail is operations-lens public-record at the parcel edge. If a well is >500ft away it is not ON or NEAR the property for the stated buyer question.
adversarialReviewCheckpoint1.onVsNearAttack: ATTEMPTED REFUTE: near-parcel could double-count a well on a shared boundary — MITIGATED: on-parcel takes precedence; near-parcel only emitted when PIP is false.
adversarialReviewCheckpoint1.verdict: ACCEPTED with noted limitation: Harris mirror returns zero wells for Dallas/Bexar; dry-run validates absence path and planner math, not present-well join density.
